root_cause_summary: Catalog records used human/status vocabulary that the current oya-foundry-catalog-domain parser does not accept: local-foundation-reviewed, retired-compatibility, plane none, API stability retired/not-applicable, empty data class lists, and AUDIT in privacy data classes.
The workspace contained packages without registry/catalog rows, so architecture-boundaries could not evaluate package roles for the full workspace.

A few new catalog rows initially exposed existing architecture role drift: payments charge grpc/rest/usecase and audit-chain API DTO crates needed catalog roles that reflect current dependency direction until a future code cleanup/inversion ChangeSet can remove the compatibility note.

Converted retired compatibility rows to validator-accepted roles/planes/API stability/data class values while preserving status: retired-compatibility-row-no-crate and non-claims.
Moved AUDIT out of data_classes_owned into operational_classes_owned where applicable.
Replaced free-form operational class labels with canonical AUDIT.
Added conservative unreviewed source-only catalog rows for existing tenancy packages.
Added conservative unreviewed source-only catalog rows for existing payments packages.
Added conservative unreviewed source-only catalog rows for existing audit-chain package split rows.
Added conservative unreviewed source-only catalog rows for existing governance, shared bounded-context checker, and shuffle-sharding packages.
Classified oya-payments-charge-usecase as application because current REST transport depends on it and the architecture gate allows rest -> application.
Classified oya-payments-charge-grpc as rest-equivalent transport until a future role vocabulary/code cleanup handles grpc explicitly.
Classified audit-chain API DTO crates as kernel-role compatibility rows because current domain crates re-export their pure DTO value types; future code cleanup should invert or rename the crates.
Updated tasks/plan.md and tasks/todo.md with gate-truth closure state and next known master-plan-completion evidence-reference debt.
